findings.title: MEMORY.md is 260 lines; only the first part is loaded
evidence: Claude Code loads MEMORY.md up to 200 lines or 25,000 bytes. This one: 260 lines, 23,351 bytes; ~4,817 bytes are cut.
1 pointer to topic files sit past the cap and are invisible to the agent.
findings.actionText: One short line per memory (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`); move detail into the topic files.

findings.title: CLAUDE.md points to @docs/legacy-runbook.md, which does not exist
evidence: @import `@docs/legacy-runbook.md`: no file at docs/legacy-runbook.md.
The referring file is loaded in every session, so the agent is told about knowledge it cannot find.
findings.actionText: Fix the path or remove the reference.

findings.title: memory/MEMORY.md points to billing_quirks_old.md, which does not exist
evidence: MEMORY.md link `billing_quirks_old.md`: no file billing_quirks_old.md in the memory folder.

findings.actionText: Fix the path or remove the reference.

findings.title: CLAUDE.md is 482 lines, loaded in every session
evidence: 482 lines, 31,940 bytes (~8.0k tokens); the official guidance targets under 200 lines per file.
findings.actionText: Split it: keep the commands and hard rules, move the rest into path-scoped rules or referenced docs.

findings.title: Every session starts with ~13k tokens of instructions and memory
evidence: Always-loaded: ~13,037 tokens (bytes ÷ 4) vs a budget of 10,000.
By layer: User CLAUDE.md (~/.claude) 91, Project CLAUDE.md 8.0k, Rules (.claude/rules) 41, MEMORY.md index 4.6k, Skill & agent listings 286.
Largest: CLAUDE.md (~8.0k), memory/MEMORY.md (~4.6k), ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (~91).
findings.actionText: Keep only what every task needs in CLAUDE.md. Move module-specific notes into `.claude/rules/*.md` with `paths:` globs, or into docs or memory files that CLAUDE.md points to, so they load only when relevant.

findings.title: 3 passages appear in both ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.md
evidence: 3 identical passages after normalization (case, whitespace, list markers), ~197 bytes. Compared by keyed hash; no text is stored.
Both files are always loaded, so these tokens are paid twice in every session.
findings.actionText: Delete the copy in CLAUDE.md: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md already loads it in every bed.

findings.title: 1 passage appears in both .claude/rules/billing.md and CLAUDE.md
evidence: 1 identical passages after normalization (case, whitespace, list markers), ~84 bytes. Compared by keyed hash; no text is stored.
Both files are always loaded, so these tokens are paid twice in every session.
findings.actionText: Keep it in one place: .claude/rules/billing.md or CLAUDE.md, not both.

findings.title: memory/2024_migration_notes.md is not referenced from MEMORY.md or any CLAUDE.md
evidence: No MEMORY.md link, @import, or mention resolves to it.
Not recalled or read in 96 sessions in the window.
findings.actionText: Add a one-line pointer to MEMORY.md (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`) or to the CLAUDE.md that needs it, or delete it.
